subject: Question about the espresso machine before I order
body:
Hi there,

I've been looking at the coffee machine on your site for a while now and I think I'm ready to go ahead, but I wanted to ask something first. My wife and I both work early shifts, so this thing would be getting a lot of use before 6am, mostly just espresso and the occasional latte. I noticed the listing mentions a milk frother but I couldn't tell if that's the wand type or the automatic one. Honestly the wand is fine by me, I just want to know what I'd be getting.

Also, is there anything in the box besides the machine itself? I've been burned before by having to order filters separately.

Thanks,
Daniel
